Message.Name: Logon Message
Message.Description: Allows the client to login to the server.

Field.Name: CompID
Field.Description: Interface User ID (CompID) assigned to the client

Field.Name: Password
Field.Description: Password assigned to the Interface User ID (CompID)

Field.Name: New Password
Field.Description: New password for Interface User ID (CompID)

Field.Name: Protocol Version
Field.Description: Specifies the version of protocol

Message.Name: Logon Response Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a login request.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Will be zero or three if login is accepted

Field.Name: Password Expiry
Field.Description: Number of days for password expiry

Message.Name: Logout Message
Message.Description: Used by the client or server to terminate a session.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the logout

Message.Name: Heartbeat Message
Message.Description: Used by the client and server to exercise the communication line during periods of inactivity.

Message.Name: Reject Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to reject a message that does not comply with the specifications.

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Reject Reason
Field.Description: Reason for the reject

Field.Name: Message Type
Field.Description: Type of message rejected

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected message if it is available

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Message
Message.Description: Used by the client to recover missed messages through the Recovery Channel.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition the request relates to

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number immediately after that of the last message received from the partition

Message.Name: Missed Message Request Ack Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to accept or reject a request for missed messages.

Field.Name: Missed Message Status
Field.Description: Outcome of the missed message request

Message.Name: Transmission Complete Message
Message.Description: Used by the server to indicate that the transmission of missed messages is complete.

Field.Name: Transmission Status
Field.Description: Outcome of the missed message transmission

Message.Name: System Status Message
Message.Description: Disseminated in the recovery channel to indicate the status of a partition.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition the message relates to

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Status of the partition

Message.Name: Execution Report Message
Message.Description: Indicates the status of an order.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the matching partition

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Unique Identifier of the Execution Report

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the order, order cancel request or order cancel replace request

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order

Field.Name: Execution Type
Field.Description: Execution Type of the order

Field.Name: Order Status
Field.Description: Status of the order

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Executed Price
Field.Description: Executed price of the trade in Zac

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Executed quantity

Field.Name: Leaves Quantity
Field.Description: Quantity available for further execution

Field.Name: Working Indicator
Field.Description: Whether the order is currently being worked on

Field.Name: Security ID
Field.Description: Identifier of the instrument the Execution Report is sent for

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order

Field.Name: Trader Mnemonic
Field.Description: Concatenated identifier of the Trader Group and the JSE Trader ID

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Client Account information

Field.Name: Is Market Ops Request
Field.Description: Whether the request was submitted by Market Operations

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the Execution Report was generated

Field.Name: Order Book
Field.Description: Order book the order belongs to

Field.Name: Execution Instruction
Field.Description: Whether hidden limit orders are excluded

Field.Name: Multi Leg Reporting Type
Field.Description: Type of trade

Field.Name: Last Opt Px
Field.Description: Price or Converted volatility of the executed options instrument

Field.Name: Volatility
Field.Description: Volatility or Converted Volatility of the executed price of the options instrument

Field.Name: Secondary Trade Report ID
Field.Description: Client specified additional order identifier of the new order or order cancel replace request

Field.Name: Indicator Flags
Field.Description: Denotes whether a given side of the trade is the aggressor side or the passive side

Message.Name: Order Cancel Reject Message
Message.Description: Indicates that an order cancel or cancel replace request has been rejected.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the matching partition

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected cancel or cancel replace request

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order for which the cancel or cancel replace was submitted

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the Order Cancel Reject occurred

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Order Book
Field.Description: Order book the order belongs to

Field.Name: RFQ ID
Field.Description: Client specified RFQ ID for a rejected order cancel submitted for a quote

Message.Name: Order Mass Cancel Report Message
Message.Description: Indicates the outcome of an order mass cancel request.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the matching partition

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the mass cancel request

Field.Name: Mass Cancel Status
Field.Description: Outcome of the mass cancel request

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the order mass cancel report was generated

Field.Name: Order Book
Field.Description: Order book the orders belong to

Message.Name: Security Definition Response Message
Message.Description: Indicates that a Security Definition Request has been accepted or rejected.

Field.Name: Security Request ID
Field.Description: Security Request ID of the Security Definition Request

Field.Name: Security Response Type
Field.Description: Outcome of the Security Definition Request

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Security ID
Field.Description: Exchange defined Security ID for the instrument when the request is accepted

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: Value submitted in the Security Definition Request

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the partition

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the partition

Field.Name: Orig Time
Field.Description: Time the announcement was published

Field.Name: Urgency
Field.Description: Urgency of the announcement

Field.Name: Headline
Field.Description: Headline or subject of market operations announcement

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Text of the market operations announcement

Field.Name: Instruments
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of symbols of the instruments the announcements relate to

Field.Name: Underlyings
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of symbols of underlyings the instruments relate to

Field.Name: Firm List
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of firms that the announcement should be sent to

Field.Name: User List
Field.Description: Pipe separated list of users that the announcement should be sent to

Message.Name: Business Reject Message
Message.Description: Indicates that an application message could not be processed.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Identity of the matching partition

Field.Name: Sequence Number
Field.Description: Message sequence number of the matching partition

Field.Name: Reject Code
Field.Description: Code specifying the reason for the reject

Field.Name: Client Order ID
Field.Description: Client specified identifier of the rejected message if it is available

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: Server specified identifier of the order for which the cancel or cancel replace was submitted

Field.Name: Transact Time
Field.Description: Time the order mass cancel report was generated

Value.Name: Order is not currently in a working state
Do Not Exclude Hidden Limit Orders
Leg Trade of a Multi-Leg Instrument

Bitfield.Name: Indicator Flags
Bitfield.Description: Aggressor or passive side of the trade

Field.Name: Aggressor Indicator
Field.Description: Whether the order initiator is the aggressor
